introduction: Virginia Cardinal Care and FAMIS provide health coverage through qualifying Medicaid and children’s coverage categories. Apply for a full eligibility review.
description: Virginia Cardinal Care and FAMIS provide health coverage through qualifying Medicaid and children’s coverage categories. Apply for a full eligibility review.

sections.who: Age, income, household, status and other category rules apply. FAMIS covers qualifying uninsured children younger than 19; some disability categories have different rules.
sections.get: Coverage includes medical care and related services. Children’s Medicaid and FAMIS have no costs for covered services under the current state information.
sections.docs:
• Names, birth dates and requested identity or status records.
  • Family income and tax information.
  • Current insurance and job-based coverage details.
sections.apply:
1. Apply

    Use CommonHelp, Cover Virginia at 833-522-5582, or a paper form through local DSS.

  2. Provide requested evidence

    Follow the document-request letter and use its submission instructions.

  3. Review coverage

    Check effective dates and follow managed-care enrollment instructions.
sections.after: Keep the case current and respond to renewals. Ask for an application assister if the process is difficult.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using DMAS application; Children and FAMIS. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Can a child qualify when adults do not?
Eligibility categories differ; apply for a full review.
Is every category governed by the same income limit?
No. Category and household circumstances matter.
